backend/data/parsed_results/2004/XC/pvc0.notes: Parser pattern (ColumnStrategyParser, 'pvc04*sl.txt.htm' = PVC Championship scored by school size). The source has two sections, 'Large School Results' (places 1-66, schools prefixed 'AB-', e.g. '  1 Corey DeWitt  SO AB-Ellsworth  5:31.9  16:55.43    1') and 'Small school Results' (places 1-60, prefix 'CD-', '  1 Lexi Wakeling  SR CD-Orono ...'), each with its own place numbering and its own team scoreboard ('Large School Results' / 'Small school Results' under Team Scores). The parse puts all 126 rows into ONE event (places 1..66 then 1..60 repeat), so the checker mixes the two fields. It should be two events: Boys 3.06 Mile Run CC Varsity, Large School (AB-, 66 rows) and Small School (CD-, 60 rows), each with its own team_rankings (AB: John Bapst 63, Hampden 76, Ellsworth 76, Caribou 86, MDI 116, Old Town 131, Brewer 141, Presque Isle 191, Bangor 221, Hermon 310; CD: Central 69, Orono 77, Sumner 85, Lee 89, Mattanawcook 123, Schenck 152, GSA 152, Foxcroft 184, PCHS 204). Verified by splitting the 126 parsed rows at row 66: every printed total reproduces in both halves (e.g. John Bapst 2+4+12+20+25=63; Central 5+12+15+18+19=69; GSA 7+17+37+43+48=152). Rows themselves match the source. The 'AB-'/'CD-' prefix is the class tag and the parser should strip it into division. School finding: 'AB-Bucksport' (Tommy Cyr, place 43, one runner, no points) resolved to '?' -> it is Bucksport (me-hs-bucksport), the prefix just blocks the match; also the same race/athletes are in pvc04bv.txt (overall scoring, 1-decimal times), so these two files double-list the 126 athletes.

Same parser pattern as pvc04bvsl.txt (ColumnStrategyParser, PVC Championship scored by school size): the source has 'Large School Results' (63 rows, schools 'AB-...', places 1-63) and 'Small school Results' (35 rows, 'CD-...', places 1-35), each with its own team scoreboard, but the parse merges all 98 rows into one event (places repeat). Split at row 63 and every printed total reproduces: AB John Bapst 36 (2+3+6+12+13), Old Town 72, MDI 80, Hampden 112, Bangor 117, Caribou 147, Ellsworth 168, Brewer 206, Bucksport 228, Presque Isle 262; CD Lee Academy 39 (4+6+7+9+13), Foxcroft 49, Sumner 67, GSA 69. It should be two events (Girls 3.06 Mile Run CC Varsity, Large School / Small School) with the AB-/CD- tag read as class/division, not part of the school. School findings: 'CD-Dexter' (1 runner) and 'CD-Mattanawcook' (1 runner) resolved to '?' here although the same strings resolve in the boys file (me-hs-dexter, me-hs-mattanawcook): they are Dexter and Mattanawcook Academy.
